type.quote: There is hereby created within the department of commerce, the Ohio construction industry licensing board, consisting of seventeen residents of this state. The board shall have an administrative section and three specialty sections: a plumbing and hydronics section, an electrical section, and a heating, ventilating, air conditioning, and refrigeration section.

umbrella_agency.quote: There is hereby created within the department of commerce, the Ohio construction industry licensing board

age_minimum.quote: Be at least eighteen years of age;

moral_character_required.quote: no specialty section of the board shall adopt, maintain, renew, or enforce any rule, or otherwise preclude in any way, an individual from renewing a license under this chapter due to any past criminal activity or interpretation of moral character.

required.quote: Either have been a tradesperson in the type of licensed trade for which the application is filed for not less than five years immediately prior to the date the application is filed, be a currently registered engineer in this state with three years of business experience in the construction industry in the trade for which the engineer is applying to take an examination, or have other experience acceptable to the appropriate specialty section of the board;

exams.name: Electrical Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must attain a passing score within the twelve months preceding the application for licensure. Applicant may retake no sooner than 60 days after most recent exam; after 5 failures must reapply before retaking.
exams.quote: When an applicant for licensure as a contractor in a licensed trade meets the qualifications set forth in division (B), (C), or (D) of this section and passes the required examination, the appropriate specialty section of the board, within ninety days after the application was filed, shall authorize the administrative section of the board to license the applicant

interval_years.quote: All licenses a contractor holds pursuant to this chapter shall expire annually on the same date

required.quote: A requirement that an individual who holds any number of valid and unexpired licenses accrue a total of ten hours of continuing education courses per year;

hours_per_period.quote: A requirement that an individual who holds any number of valid and unexpired licenses accrue a total of ten hours of continuing education courses per year;

value: No curriculum may require more than five hours per year in specific course requirements
topical_requirements.quote: No curriculum may require more than five hours per year in specific course requirements. No contractor may be required to take more than ten hours per year in continuing education courses.

available.quote: When a written reciprocity agreement between the states exists, and an individual who is registered, licensed, or certified in another state applies to the appropriate specialty section of the Ohio construction industry licensing board submits a copy of the reciprocity agreement, and pays the licensure fee determined pursuant to section 4740.09 of the Revised Code, the appropriate specialty section of the board shall authorize the administrative section to issue, without examination, a license to that individual

requirements.value: A written reciprocity agreement between states must exist; the applicant must submit a copy of the agreement, pay the licensure fee, and the specialty section must determine requirements are substantially equal and that the other state extends similar reciprocity.
requirements.quote: the appropriate specialty section of the board shall authorize the administrative section to issue, without examination, a license to that individual if the appropriate specialty section of the board determines, pursuant to rules it adopts, that the requirements for registration, licensure, or certification under the laws of the other state are substantially equal to the requirements for licensure in this state and that the other state extends similar reciprocity to persons licensed under this chapter.

value: Control wiring less than 25 volts for equipment related to a contractor's specific license
Construction, improvement, renovation, repair, testing, or maintenance of fire alarm or burglar alarm systems using less than 50 volts
Cabling, tele-data sound, communication systems using less than 50 volts
Landscape lighting and irrigation systems using less than 50 volts
scope_exclusions.quote: A contractor licensed under this chapter may install, service, and maintain the related or interfaced control wiring for equipment and devices related to their specific license, on the condition that the control wiring is less than twenty-five volts. A person is not an electrical contractor subject to licensure under this chapter for work that is limited to the construction, improvement, renovation, repair, testing, or maintenance of the following systems using less than fifty volts of electricity: fire alarm or burglar alarm, cabling, tele-data sound, communication, and landscape lighting and irrigation.
